read.en: Micron rose 2.0% on Oct 21 to $913.67, trading between $889.45 and $928.45. It is above the falling 5-day average ($904.9) and the rising 200-day ($726.9), but below the falling 10-day ($944.6) and 30-day ($1,003.3) and the rising 100-day ($976.5). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 6 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 7 ($999.67), and RSI is 41.
read.zh: 美光 10月21日上涨 2.0%，收于 $913.67，盘中区间 $889.45–928.45。股价位于下行的 5 日均线（$904.9）和上行的 200 日均线（$726.9）上方，但低于下行的 10 日（$944.6）和 30 日均线（$1,003.3）以及上行的 100 日均线（$976.5）。MACD 自 10月6日起位于信号线及零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月7日起看空（$999.67），RSI 为 41。

read.en: The close reclaimed $903–905 (Sep 14 low, 5-day average), lost on Oct 20, and it turns to support. Resistance is $926.8–931.7 (Oct 19 and 15 highs), then $944.6 (10-day) and $976.5 (100-day). Support is $903–905, then $881.5–889.5 (Oct 20 and 21 lows) and $854–858 (Jun 9, Oct 15 lows). A close above $932 would open $944.6; a close below $881 would open $856.
